description: This PHP class defines the entity 'LeaveType' used in the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It models the leave type with properties like id, name, whether it is situational, deletion status, and associated operational country, using Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: LeaveType
classes.description: Entity class representing a Leave Type in the HRM system, with properties for id, name, situational status, deletion status, and associated operational country, utilizing Doctrine ORM annotations for persistence.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the leave type.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the leave type.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the leave type.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the leave type.

methods.name: isSituational
methods.description: Indicates whether the leave type is situational.

methods.name: setSituational
methods.description: Sets whether the leave type is situational.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Indicates whether the leave type is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Marks the leave type as deleted or active.

methods.name: getOperationalCountry
methods.description: Returns the operational country associated with the leave type.

methods.name: setOperationalCountry
methods.description: Sets the operational country associated with the leave type.
